premises.text: Security audits, scanners, and firewalls leave a gap: audits are infrequent, scanners are noisy, firewalls too permissive
premises.evidence_span: security audits cannot be performed each time your code is changed. Scanner reports are full of false positives

premises.text: Developers have strong tooling for deploy and monitoring but security is left behind
Screen protects applications at runtime by monitoring critical functions inside the app
premises.evidence_span: Screen is a security solution that protects your application at runtime

premises.text: In-app logic-based protection blocks unknown vulnerabilities and reduces false positives, with debugger-like detail
premises.evidence_span: This allows us to block unknown vulnerabilities, because our protection is based on logic, not just patterns

premises.text: Install is as simple as adding a dependency with a few commands
premises.evidence_span: installing screen is not different from installing any other dependency in your application

premises.text: Dashboard shows attacks, suspicious user activity, and actionable backtraces for developers
premises.evidence_span: the full backtrace here in green, showing you the exact vulnerabilities in your codes, all in one place

premises.text: Pricing starts at $99/month and scales with hosts; available for Python, Rails, and Node.js
premises.evidence_span: our pricing starts at only $99 per month and scales as you grow with the number of hosts

value.text: Developers can protect applications simply at runtime

secondary_value.text: Protect users against account takeovers and brute force
secondary_value.evidence_span: We protect your users and customers against account takeovers and brute force attacks
